sources.title: GitHub - tinnel123666888/OmniJev
sources.snippet: OmniJev is a model we trained end to end — not the Jev API with somebody else's model behind it. About 270,000 decision records and 1.3 million typed questions across web and phone operation, robot episodes (simulated and real), video events, real-time games, gestures, hazards and sounds. A 4B model that sees images and video and makes decisions about them: operate phones and computers, play ...
